credit: Image courtesy of the Earth Science and Remote Sensing Unit, NASA Johnson Space Center
sourcePhotoIDs: Page: ISS069-E-37411 through 37414; delivered panorama filename ends 37415 (discrepancy retained).
colorSpace: sRGB, published contrast-enhanced color photograph; not calibrated radiance
processing: Projective registration to NASA photo map tiles in Web Mercator; geographic resampling with Lanczos and alpha edge feather. No invented roads, emitters or colors.

registration.method: SIFT/RANSAC registration of published NASA panorama to four NASA georeferenced map tiles from original ISS069-E-37412
registration.accuracyLimit: Residual measures image agreement with NASA map tiles, not absolute ground survey accuracy. NASA georeference is an automated product; published raw footprint corner labels were inconsistent with raw image orientation and were not used.

accuracyLimit: About 14 m held-out image agreement in the fitting area, about 39 m east and 258 m west against other map tiles; these are image alignment residuals, NOT absolute geographic accuracy. Automated NASA placement is not a survey.
alpha: Smoothstep photographic coverage feather over 400 source pixels; interior observed RGB unchanged. Transition to lower-resolution 2016 VIIRS is display processing.
displayDatum: WGS84 geographic longitude/latitude mapped onto the game mean-radius spherical Earth; not an ellipsoidal terrain survey.

backgroundDisplayMatch.method: Robust median display-luminance ratio after area averaging the registered photo to the VIIRS sampling footprint. sRGB decoded before averaging.
backgroundDisplayMatch.limits: Display matching across differently processed 2016 and 2023 observations; not radiometric calibration or measurement of temporal changes.

backgroundFiltering.processing: One-texel Gaussian display reconstruction in linear light; no invented features or sharpening. Original 500 m nominal observation is retained separately.
